text_en: To the leader: with stringed instruments; according to The Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
text_cn: 达味诗歌，交与乐官，和以弦乐，八度低音。

text_en: O Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger, or discipline me in your wrath.
text_cn: 上主，求你不要在震怒中责罚我， 不要在气愤中惩戒我。

text_en: Be gracious to me, O Lord , for I am languishing; O Lord , heal me, for my bones are shaking with terror.
text_cn: 上主，我的体力衰弱，求你怜恤我； 上主，我的骨骸战栗，求你医治我；

text_en: My soul also is struck with terror, while you, O Lord —how long?
text_cn: 我的灵魂万分痛苦， 上主，何时才能结束？

text_en: Turn, O Lord , save my life; deliver me for the sake of your steadfast love.
text_cn: 上主，请你回来援助我，因了你的慈爱解救我。

text_en: For in death there is no remembrance of you; in Sheol who can give you praise?
text_cn: 因为，在死亡中，没有人想念你； 在阴府里，还有谁称颂你？

text_en: I am weary with my moaning; every night I flood my bed with tears; I drench my couch with my weeping.
text_cn: 我已哭泣疲惫，每天夜里， 常以眼泪浸湿我的床铺， 常以鼻涕流透我的被褥。

text_en: My eyes waste away because of grief; they grow weak because of all my foes.
text_cn: 我的眼睛因忧伤而昏盲， 为了仇敌众多甚感惆怅。

text_en: Depart from me, all you workers of evil, for the Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.
text_cn: 作奸犯科的人快快远离我， 因为上主听见了我的悲号；

text_en: The Lord has heard my supplication; the Lord accepts my prayer.
text_cn: 上主俯允了我的哀告， 上主悦纳了我的祈祷。

text_en: All my enemies shall be ashamed and struck with terror; they shall turn back, and in a moment be put to shame.
text_cn: 我的仇敌必要受辱惊慌， 转瞬之间必会含羞逃亡。
